messages:
jamal: heads up — deploy-bot flagged the release window for v2.8.1, promotion held by CI.
deploy-bot: Promotion hold: release=v2.8.1 reason=artifact_upload_timeout -> affected-pipeline=build-release-21 job=upload-artifacts
ci-bot: Build log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20T16:12:34Z] Uploading artifact chunk 4/12
[2026-03-20T16:12:35Z] ERROR: Upload failed: ELOCK - cache shard 42 locked by job #1845 (node: runner-12)
[2026-03-20T16:12:36Z] Retrying upload (attempt 2/5)
[2026-03-20T16:13:05Z] ERROR: Upload failed: ELOCK - cache shard 42 locked by job #1845
[2026-03-20T16:13:40Z] ERROR: Upload failed: timeout after 2 retries
```
priya: :eyes: same shard keeps getting held by a concurrent post-submit job. I can try killing job #1845 but that might affect another team's run.
sara: what's the impact if we don't promote? do customers see anything?
jamal: Canary is blocked. If we wait for retries, release window closes in 2h. We should decide: force-promote previous artifact or unstick the cache and re-run.
martin: I can drop the lock from the cache service if infra approves — quick fix: `curl -X POST https://cache.internal/locks/42/unlock -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN"` (requires infra ops audit)
alex: Alternative: pin to last-good artifact `redwood/release:v2.8.0-20260319` and promote that to prod now, then debug offline. Less risky during change window.
emily: If we pin we need release notes update and rollback plan. Also alert support channel for the minor functional diff.
priya: +1 to pin. We avoid an emergency infra unlock and potential side-effects. Is there a quick smoke to confirm v2.8.0 works with the config in this environment?
jamal: Running smoke now against the pinned artifact:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --image redwood/release:v2.8.0-20260319 --env staging
```
ci-bot: Smoke result: 5/5 checks passed (latency ok, basic QA flows ok) — timestamp 2026-03-20T16:18:12Z
jamal: Decision: pin -> promote previous artifact. I'll open the manual promote and annotate reasons.
deploy-bot: Manual promote created: action_id=mp-8843 actor=jamal target=redwood/release:v2.8.0-20260319 scheduled=now
martin: Filing infra ticket to investigate shard contention: INFRA-4821. I'll not force-unlock; we'll debug the cache eviction pattern and job scheduling.
emily: I'll patch release notes: add a note that v2.8.1 promotion deferred due to CI artifact upload failure; documenting pinned release and rollback steps.
jamal: Can someone ping @platform-oncall to keep an eye on any rollout anomalies? also add a changelog line and update the release checklist.
priya: pinged @platform-oncall in #eng-oncall. Also requeued build-release-21 to run after shard release — if it succeeds we'll consider a reattempt outside the change window.
sara: OK. Summary for postmortem: cause=cache shard lease collision, impact=blocked canary for v2.8.1, mitigation=pinned to v2.8.0, follow-up=INFRA-4821 + re-run build-release-21 after investigation.
jamal: thanks all. I'll update the release doc and close the promotion hold. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Promotion hold cleared: release=v2.8.1 note="pinned to v2.8.0 due to CI upload lock (INFRA-4821)" actor=jamal time=2026-03-20T16:32:00Z
